title: Carry and divisor-channel criteria for the factorial-minus-one reciprocal series
summary: For the reciprocal series with denominators n! - 1, the selected Lean theorems give an exact carry characterization of rationality, divisor-channel coordinates, and a finite gcd moment certificate. Companion-orbit and complementary tail criteria are included with their stated hypotheses. These structural results do not certify the paper's large computed denominator exclusions or resolve the irrationality question.

review.reason: Carry and divisor criteria for reciprocal series with factorial-minus-one denominators.
